theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+2.68%) and Technology (+1.09%) led the market today, while Consumer Staples (-1.99%) and Consumer Discretionary (-1.31%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.22%, defensives -1.17%, and value/cyclicals +0.01% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. That shows up at the index level too: the tech-heavy Nasdaq gained +0.13% while the blue-chip Dow lagged at -0.95%. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -0.22%. The VIX rose 1.05% to 19.24, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.28% to $4,018.70, crude oil was little changed at $102.86, and bitcoin gained 0.26% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
